changeSet.sql:
create or alter procedure [graph].[SynchronizeRelationshipExecution] @executionUid uniqueidentifier as begin set nocount on; declare @method varchar(7) = ''; select @method = upper(Method) from api.Execution where ExecutionID = @executionUid;
declare @currentUid uniqueidentifier
drop table if exists #relationshipsToUpdate create table #relationshipsToUpdate(uid uniqueidentifier)
if (@method = 'POST' OR @method = 'PUT') and exists(select 1 from api.ExecutionRelationship where ExecutionID = @executionUid) begin insert into #relationshipsToUpdate select uid from api.ExecutionRelationship where executionid = @executionUid and uid is not null order by uid desc
set @currentUid = (select top 1 uid from #relationshipsToUpdate order by uid desc)
while @currentUid is not null begin exec graph.UpdateAssetEdge @currentUid delete from #relationshipsToUpdate where uid in ((select top 1 uid from #relationshipsToUpdate order by uid desc)) set @currentUid = (select top 1 uid from #relationshipsToUpdate order by uid desc) end end
if (@method = 'DELETE') and exists(select 1 from api.ExecutionDeletedRelationship where ExecutionID = @executionUid) begin insert into #relationshipsToUpdate select uid from api.ExecutionDeletedRelationship where executionid = @executionUid and uid is not null order by uid desc
set @currentUid = (select top 1 uid from #relationshipsToUpdate order by uid desc)
while @currentUid is not null begin exec graph.UpdateAssetEdge @currentUid delete from #relationshipsToUpdate where uid in ((select top 1 uid from #relationshipsToUpdate order by uid desc)) set @currentUid = (select top 1 uid from #relationshipsToUpdate order by uid desc) end end end
